inputs: A work order and its developer or reviewer packet, read off disk from a state directory
A runner configuration naming the repository, the workspace root and the backend
invariants: A separate program: it imports no company, ai_platform, knowledge or intelligence module, and architecture.production_does_not_import_company_os proves that on every gate run.
Company OS does not import the runner either. The halves meet as files, and only tests/test_company_external_engineering_runner.py imports both.
It restates four control-plane contracts - path scope, job states, required suites, receipt shape - and the drift test pins each to its original.
Owning this path is governance responsibility, not production authority. Nothing here merges, deploys, publishes or uploads.
Ceilings are applied in-process. Without an OS sandbox the runner cannot stop a session reading wider, and it reports that limit rather than claiming enforcement.
An absent read ceiling grants no read authority rather than unrestricted authority.
The no-subagent policy is restated here and may not be weakened.
outputs: A receipt or a reviewer attestation, written where Company OS reads it
An exploration report, resource telemetry, and a run log scrubbed of secrets and absolute paths
purpose: Owns the external engineering runner: the separate program that takes a work order off disk, leases a workspace, drives a coding session under the order's ceilings, and writes back a receipt. Ownership exists so runner changes get a bounded work order and an independent review.
risks: tools/ is a declared production root, so the production-import check and the research guards apply to every change made here.
The runner's copies of control-plane contracts drift silently; only the drift test catches it.
Objective tokens alone never select this capsule: intake turns tokens into company/<token> signals, so a path-shaped subsystem_hint or a capsule hint is required.
Seven capsules forbid tools/**. A work order co-selecting one of them with this capsule inherits the broader rule, and forbidden wins.
title: External engineering runner
